## 🎯 Content and goals

- You understand use cases for different kinds of AI models.
- You know common AI tools for different tasks.
- You know the basics on how to write good prompts.
- You are aware of the main caveats and ethical issues of using AI.
- You can disclose and document the use of AI.
- You understand the business models of AI companies.

## 🧰 Templates and resources

Two companion resources support this lecture. Each is available on the website and
as a download (PDF, MS Word, and Markdown source):

- [**Documenting and disclosing the use of AI**](ai-disclosure/index.qmd) — a
  fillable template plus a worked example for declaring AI use in your term papers
  and coursework.
- [**Writing effective AI prompts**](ai-prompting/index.qmd) — a practical guide
  with a quick prompt skeleton and a more advanced meta-prompt.

## ✍️ Exercises and coursework

*Suggested exercises (to help you remember the material; not graded):*

- Try the different tools introduced and decide which one you want to use.
- Familiarize yourself with the practice of prompting.
